metadata.scope: Phase 0 / U-004 second remediation and its exact evidence gate

executiveSummary.text: The second remediation closes the three prior Medium findings and most prior Low findings. The normal upload contract is now honest, exact 6-suite/25-testcase discovery is enforced, active documentation is aligned, production documentation paths are closed, and the real DataScope mapper chain is tested. CHANGES_REQUESTED remains because the gate does not revalidate HEAD after Maven and target markers are not bound to actual datasource, Redis, or MinIO targets. Three Low findings cover verifier path/source boundaries, an overchecked application-context item, and a 24-of-32 parameter matrix. Final real-dependency evidence has not been executed.

previousFindingClosure.finding: P00-R1-M1 generic MD5 deduplication false closure
P00-R1-L4 DataScope specification and test-layer drift

topRisks.title: Gate does not revalidate HEAD after Maven
Target markers are not bound to actual connection targets
Evidence verifier source and Windows path boundaries are incomplete

detailedFindings.title: Gate does not revalidate HEAD after Maven

evidence.relevantBehavior: HEAD is read only before Maven; end checks only prove the then-current worktree is clean while the manifest retains the start SHA.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A clean checkout changes HEAD during Maven, and evidence from the new commit is attributed to the starting commit.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Require endHead equals startHead equals expectedCandidateSha and add a head-drift unit test.

detailedFindings.title: Target markers are not bound to actual connection targets

evidence.relevantBehavior: Markers receive syntax and secret-shape validation but are not compared to datasource, Redis, or MinIO configuration or runtime identity.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A stale datasource URL points to a shared database while the independently entered marker labels it as a fresh isolated schema.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Cross-check normalized marker and connection configuration and record credential-free runtime service identity.

detailedFindings.title: Evidence verifier source and Windows path boundaries are incomplete

evidence.relevantBehavior: PurePosixPath validation accepts Windows drive, UNC, and backslash traversal forms; source fields and spec hash are not all mandatory.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A malformed evidence path is read and hashed outside evidence_dir before exact directory coverage rejects the package.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Enforce resolved containment before access and require exact source path/hash plus a spec hash.

detailedFindings.title: Application context startup is checked before it was executed

evidence.relevantBehavior: The checklist combines proven packaging and unexecuted application-context startup under one completed item.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A final-candidate context-start failure is hidden behind a package-only green check.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Split package as completed from application-context startup as pending.

detailedFindings.title: Parameter matrix covers 24 of 32 current defaults

evidence.relevantBehavior: The test queries only the 24 documented keys and cannot detect drift or removal in eight other migration-defined defaults.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A security, file, or video parameter disappears while the all-documented-defaults test remains green.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Expand to all 32 current defaults or explicitly name and document the 24-key subset.

safetyBoundary.gitMutations: no stage, commit, merge, push, or deploy

nextGate: Fix or explicitly disposition P00-R2-L1 through P00-R2-L3.
Run the final-HEAD exact 6-suite/25-testcase gate in an authorized fresh isolated MySQL, Redis, and MinIO stack.
Provide docker compose config and any required non-production browser evidence.
Perform an independent evidence-only incremental review before Phase 0 PASS.
